+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
+<class name="ModifierBoneTarget3D" inherits="SkeletonModifier3D" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="../class.xsd">
+	<brief_description>
+		А node that dynamically copies the 3D transform of a bone in its parent [Skeleton3D].
+	</brief_description>
+	<description>
+		This node selects a bone in a [Skeleton3D] and attaches to it. This means that the [ModifierBoneTarget3D] node will either dynamically copy the 3D transform of the selected bone.
+		There is similar functionality to [BoneAttachment3D], but this node adopts the [SkeletonModifier3D] cycle and is intended to be used as other [SkeletonModifier3D]'s target.
body:
```suggestion
		The functionality is similar to [BoneAttachment3D], but this node adopts the [SkeletonModifier3D] cycle and is intended to be used as another [SkeletonModifier3D]'s target.
```
Since when influence is less than 1.0, interpolation is performed within Skeleton3D even if there is no change bone pose, so I'm worried about a drop in performance and I made it like this.
